thread:
Sam: Heads up — bringing up `sable-hybrid` (LLama->Gemma conversion) on int4. Small evals look fine until ~120 tokens, then we get garbage / <unk>-heavy outputs. Anyone seen ZWJ/zero-width quirks during vocab conversion?

Mia: Did you run the conversion script from tools/convert_vocab.py or the older hand-merge? link: https://gist.github.com/example (quick reference)

Sam: Used tools/convert_vocab.py + rotary-scale=0.98, quant=q4f. Repro snippet from inference log: 
```
[INF] step 122 token=345 logp=-3.2
[INF] step 123 token=0 logp=-12.1
[WARN] EOS token mapped to 0 after conversion
```

Raj: That smells like a token-id collision after trimming. ZWJ (U+200D) or other control chars can end up reindexed. Did you normalise the tokenizer (NFKC/NFKD)?

Sam: I ran NFKC before conversion. The original vocab had a sentinel at index 2 for ‍. After conversion I think the converter trimmed low-frequency tokens and shifted indices; pad ended up at 0 (fine) but zwj moved to 0 in the converted mapping which confused kv-cache assumptions.

Jen: Can you paste first 8 tokens from the raw vocab? Quick command: `python -c "import json;print(list(json.load(open('vocab.json'))[:8]))"`

Sam: Pasted top-8 from source vocab: ["<pad>","<unk>","‍","the","I","to","a","is"]

Mia: Bingo — ‍ at index 2. If conversion trims leading slots or reassigns control chars to index 0, any cached indices or positional heuristics break. kv-cache/prefix-cache logic assumes pad=0; other reserved chars must stay at their original slots or be remapped consistently.

Raj: Also check how rotary phase is applied. If the runtime used token_id as a proxy for position in some fallback path (bug), a remap will cause phase drift after the remap point. That would show as severe logprob drop once remapped tokens appear.

Sam: Re-ran conversion with an explicit remap table preserving control-char indices (kept zwj at 2, pad=0). Also disabled the automatic low-freq trim. Perplexities: baseline 12.4 -> converted-without-remap 18.9 -> converted-with-remap 12.6. Regression gone.

Jen: Great. Action items: add a conversion-lint that fails if control characters (ZWJ/ZWSP/NBSP) land at index 0 or collide with pad/EOS/UNK.

ci-bot: build 1203 passed for conversion-toolkit on branch model/onboard/sable-hybrid :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Deploying dedicated pool for shelf tests in us-west-2, job id j-7745

Mia: Also propose an eval that validates token continuity for first 256 tokens and asserts mean logp delta < 0.2 vs baseline across 3 seeds.

Sam: I'll open a PR with the conversion patch + two tests (lint + continuity eval).

Raj: Assign to Sam, cc Jen for review.

Jen: lgtm, and please add a short note to onboarding.md about rotary-scaling caveat when vocab indices are reordered — saved us debugging time today.

Sam: Thanks all :thumbsup:
summary: Onboarding: vocab conversion moved control char (ZWJ) index, causing kv-cache/rotary phase mismatches; fixed by explicit remap and adding lint + eval tests
